run_GTNLoss: run the GTNLoss function to compute sequence loss between frame-level inputs and token-level targets

build_make_target_graph: build a target graph from a token sequence where each token can align to multiple input frames

review_GTNLoss: review the GTNLoss alias and GTNLossFunction class for integrating GTN graph-based loss into PyTorch models
